whyThisMatters:
Subscription site publishing detailed (soccer) tactical analysis, scout reports, coach analysis and stats since 2018; claims "all Premier League clubs" among subscribers. Founded (company) Apr 2020, US. 1,154 active subscriptions; profit margin on the recent snapshot 71%. Seller says the sale includes 20 freelance writers + an editor, owner spends <1 hour/week, and Stripe revenue excludes PayPal.

A content membership with a writer bench — a paywalled trade publication for coaches, scouts and analysts. Over 1,000 subs paying for PDFs-and-articles is classic boring cash. But revenue has been sliding for a year.

The product is the writing. Match reports, scout notes, and stats, on a subscription, since 2018. The seller says Premier League clubs are among the readers, that a sale would include freelance writers and an editor, and that the owner spends less than an hour a week. PayPal sits outside the Stripe number. The recent months are softer than the older total.
